corpus.title: Claim Commons 2026 Literature Snapshot
corpus.dedupe_rule: normalised title across preprint and publication records; DOI retained as provenance when available
corpus.source_notice: Bibliographic metadata and short claim cues are used for discovery. Source documents retain their original rights and licences.
corpus.extraction_notice: Every extracted statement and typed bridge is an abstract-level, unreviewed candidate cue. Full-text review, endpoint resolution, and human confirmation are required before any record can complete a Helix area.
corpus.gap_notice: An empty segment is a corpus gap in this snapshot, not proof that the wider field lacks relevant research.

excluded: non-English records when language is known
records without a neuroscience, learning, adaptive-agent or physical-computing anchor

scope.notice: Observed public-source coverage, not a guarantee of exhaustive author/project bibliography. Project objectives are not experimental results.

supplemental_batches.scope: Classic supervision, reward representation, causal pathways and learning interventions, human evidence and boundaries; not the entire bibliography.
User-authorized correction of existing full source extraction; original candidate preserved.
All unfinished PDF files in the user references folder; complete sources retained as unreviewed candidates, not necessarily independent papers.

areas.gap_question: 哪个真实生物变量需要被测量或操纵？
areas.completion_requirement: 有界的生物学 Claim、独立单位、设计或干预、观测结果与不确定性。

areas.gap_question: 哪个可测变量对应哪个理论原语？
areas.completion_requirement: 显式映射实验变量与数学变量，并给出竞争抽象及可区分观测。

areas.gap_question: 哪些假设与约束能够产生可判别预测？
areas.completion_requirement: 显式假设、状态变量、适用边界，以及至少一个区分竞争机制的预测。

areas.gap_question: 理论原则如何由局部可用信息近似？
areas.completion_requirement: 连接规范目标与可执行规则，列明局部、广播和全局信号及失效条件。

areas.gap_question: 哪条局部或在线学习规则可以实现这一原则？
areas.completion_requirement: 可执行更新规则、资源需求、对照与消融，以及可复现的学习后果。

areas.gap_question: 算法优势在真实物理成本下仍成立吗？
areas.completion_requirement: 算法—基底映射、实测能耗或时延、匹配基线、噪声与变化条件。

areas.gap_question: 闭环智能体如何分配感知、计算、记忆与能量？
areas.completion_requirement: 闭环任务、真实物理指标、变化条件及性能—成本—适应性边界。

areas.gap_question: 机器发现能提出哪个新的判别性生物实验？
areas.completion_requirement: 新的生物变量、竞争机制 A/B、分歧预测、观测方案与明确 falsifier。
